rites.name: Samhain rites
rites.text: Twenty-seven dark rites craft cores, foci and servants at an altar, paid in souls over several seconds.

rites.name: Ólu nae Marb
rites.text: Mourners prepare a fermented drink from wild grain and hold a funeral feast in a cave. Anchor: bendable, 1 stage(s). Players can delay it.

rites.name: Boildidielg
rites.text: A Druid spell of tier 1, school line druid_wild. Flings a barbed vine at a foe: its damage nature damage and a short slow.

rites.name: Driùchdu
rites.text: A Druid spell of tier 1, school line druid_grove. A bead of cool dew heals the one you look at (yourself if none): its healing health.

rites.name: Ribidries
rites.text: A Druid spell of tier 2, school line druid_wild. Briars burst from the ground at the target spot and hold anything in them: slow and light damage each pulse.

rites.name: Kraikenddaurach
rites.text: A Druid spell of tier 2, school line druid_grove. Your skin takes on oak bark for 12 seconds: resistance, at the cost of slowness.

rites.name: Slànachaddoiri
rites.text: A Druid spell of tier 3, school line druid_grove. A ring of green light heals you and every ally close by, and leaves a slow regrowth.

rites.name: Leimdaum
rites.text: A Druid spell of tier 3, school line druid_wild. You bound forward and up like a stag and take no damage from the fall that follows.

rites.name: Sliegoilìuk
rites.text: A Druid spell of tier 4, school line druid_wild. Hold to draw a white-berried spear of pith and thorn. A full draw pierces two foes and poisons them.

rites.name: Draeid
rites.text: The grove-keepers. They mend the hurt and bind the loud with root and thorn. Heals and plant control. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Draeid made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.

rites.name: Sraudagsieldad
rites.text: A Ovate spell of tier 1, school line ovate_omen. A bright flicker that stings for its damage and leaves the target outlined for 6 seconds.

rites.name: Fradurk
rites.text: A Ovate spell of tier 1, school line ovate_sight. Your eyes open to the dark for 40 seconds: night vision.

rites.name: Snàddànu
rites.text: A Ovate spell of tier 2, school line ovate_omen. You pull on the target's thread: it is weakened and slowed for 8 seconds and takes its damage.

rites.name: Keimskàili
rites.text: A Ovate spell of tier 2, school line ovate_sight. You step through the veil and appear 8 blocks ahead.

rites.name: Eòlasubradun
rites.text: A Ovate spell of tier 3, school line ovate_omen. Channel for 2.5 seconds: a stream of bright knowing cuts through everything in a line.

rites.name: Fairi
rites.text: A Ovate spell of tier 3, school line ovate_sight. Everything hostile within 14 blocks glows for 10 seconds, even behind stone.

rites.name: Boildibruodur
rites.text: A Ovate spell of tier 4, school line ovate_omen. You name a place and the blow falls there a heartbeat later: its damage to everything in 3 blocks.

rites.name: Fiusaichi
rites.text: The seers. They see what is hidden and strike where a blow is already foretold. Sight, marks and blinks. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Fiusaichi made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.

rites.name: Bilegtàirnenach
rites.text: A Bard spell of tier 1, school line bard_thunder. One struck note travels as a crackle and does its damage.

rites.name: Tàlad
rites.text: A Bard spell of tier 1, school line bard_strain. The target's limbs go heavy: slowness and weakness for 6 seconds, and it forgets its hurry.

rites.name: Kuma
rites.text: A Bard spell of tier 2, school line bard_strain. A long falling strain: nearby foes stagger back and are struck by dread: nausea for 4 seconds.

rites.name: Gàiri
rites.text: A Bard spell of tier 2, school line bard_strain. A bright strain mends you and each ally near you for its healing and quickens them for 4 seconds.

rites.name: Adurkglaed
rites.text: A Bard spell of tier 3, school line bard_thunder. A great horn blast hammers the area in front of you: its damage and a heavy shove.

rites.name: Òrunbrautach
rites.text: A Bard spell of tier 3, school line bard_strain. A marching song for 15 seconds: you and nearby allies gain speed and haste.

rites.name: Koseirmstoirmi
rites.text: A Bard spell of tier 4, school line bard_thunder. Hold a chord for 3 seconds. The sky answers along your aim and each moment of the chord strikes.

rites.name: Bàrdu
rites.text: The singers. Three strains (sleep, lament, laughter) and their thunder. Crowd control and rally. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Bàrdu made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.

rites.name: Boildirand
rites.text: A Filid spell of tier 1, school line filid_satire. A hard line of verse flies out: its damage and a short weakness.

rites.name: Randskiad
rites.text: A Filid spell of tier 1, school line filid_word. A spoken ward gives you a shield of 3 extra hearts for 20 seconds.

rites.name: Aeiri
rites.text: A Filid spell of tier 2, school line filid_satire. A cutting rhyme raises blisters on the proud: slowness, weakness and its damage to the target.

rites.name: Fìrind
rites.text: A Filid spell of tier 2, school line filid_word. A true word spoken over you and your allies strips slowing and harmful effects and heals its healing.

rites.name: Randkeid
rites.text: A Filid spell of tier 3, school line filid_satire. A rapid recital: five small bolts fan out in a spread, each doing its damage.

rites.name: Toirmesk
rites.text: A Filid spell of tier 3, school line filid_word. You lay a ban on the target: withering for 5 seconds and hunger for 15.

rites.name: Maldachd
rites.text: A Filid spell of tier 4, school line filid_satire. A dark cloud of ill words settles on the target ground for 7 seconds and keeps cursing what stands in it.

rites.name: Filid
rites.text: The poets of law and satire. Their words wound, bind and shield. Curses, wards and cleansing. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Filid made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.

rites.name: Boildifiendag
rites.text: A Raven spell of tier 1, school line fitech_terror. Two quick strikes, like a crow at carrion. Each hits for its damage.

rites.name: Glaedkad
rites.text: A Raven spell of tier 1, school line fitech_battle. A raven-throated shout: you and allies near you gain strength for 10 seconds.

rites.name: Leimfitech
rites.text: A Raven spell of tier 2, school line fitech_battle. You throw yourself forward in a low leap with a speed burst.

rites.name: Bàinid
rites.text: A Raven spell of tier 2, school line fitech_battle. You fall into fury for 8 seconds: strong blows, but you take more harm (weaker defence).

rites.name: Roudspoiri
rites.text: A Raven spell of tier 3, school line fitech_terror. A full spin: three sweeping cuts that hit everything around you for its damage each.

rites.name: Oildti
rites.text: A Raven spell of tier 3, school line fitech_terror. Dread shakes nearby foes: they are shoved back and weakened for 6 seconds.

rites.name: Àdbàsu
rites.text: A Raven spell of tier 4, school line fitech_terror. A single heavy stroke. Foes under a third of their health take triple damage.

rites.name: Fitech
rites.text: The war-crow's way. Short sharp melee strikes, battle shouts and fear. Scales with melee power. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Fitech made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.

rites.name: Kietach
rites.text: A Otherworld spell of tier 1, school line sidhe_frost. A cold white mist rises where you point: it clings, slows and nips for 6 seconds.

rites.name: Loindskàili
rites.text: A Otherworld spell of tier 1, school line sidhe_glamour. A veil of glamour: you are unseen for 6 seconds and quick for 3.

rites.name: Keimknok
rites.text: A Otherworld spell of tier 2, school line sidhe_glamour. You step inside the hill and out again 12 blocks ahead.

rites.name: Tiudlak
rites.text: A Otherworld spell of tier 2, school line sidhe_glamour. A gift from the hill: the target regains its healing health over 10 seconds, and is lightly shielded.

rites.name: Geigairged
rites.text: A Otherworld spell of tier 3, school line sidhe_frost. A bright branch flies out and passes through two foes. Each is chilled and takes its damage.

rites.name: Uoirsìtichi
rites.text: A Otherworld spell of tier 3, school line sidhe_frost. Time thickens around you: foes within 7 blocks crawl for 3 seconds and are nipped by frost.

rites.name: Klachmelduin
rites.text: A Otherworld spell of tier 4, school line sidhe_frost. A hail of stones falls around the target spot: its damage to each foe struck, with a chill.

rites.name: Sìtichi
rites.text: The hollow-hill folk. Mist, glamour and gifts that come with a price. Control and mobility. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Sìtichi made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.

rites.name: Sraudag
rites.text: A Smith spell of tier 1, school line smith_fire. A spark spits from the fire: its damage and burning for 3 seconds.

rites.name: Kaisk
rites.text: A Smith spell of tier 1, school line smith_temper. You plunge your hands in the quench-trough: fire resistance for 40 seconds and any fire on you goes out.

rites.name: Iarnaigitied
rites.text: A Smith spell of tier 2, school line smith_fire. Hold to heat the iron. A full draw hurls a white-hot bolt that does its damage and sets the foe alight.

rites.name: Kaisiiarnaigi
rites.text: A Smith spell of tier 2, school line smith_temper. You temper your body for 10 seconds: haste, strength and resistance, then a short tiredness.

rites.name: Skòdsaliaruind
rites.text: A Smith spell of tier 3, school line smith_fire. A cloud of hot slag settles at the target spot for 6 seconds and keeps burning what stands in it.

rites.name: Anuilkum
rites.text: A Smith spell of tier 3, school line smith_fire. Channel the bellows for 2.5 seconds: a lance of heat along your aim, burning all it crosses.

rites.name: Oiskiliegti
rites.text: A Smith spell of tier 4, school line smith_fire. A rain of molten iron falls around the target spot: its damage to each drop's blast and burning.

rites.name: Gouba
rites.text: The forge-masters. Fire from the hearth: sparks, hot iron and the long pour. Damage over time and self-tempering. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Gouba made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.

rites.name: Seòmureisluinti kriadach
rites.text: The Seòmureisluinti kriadach is a concept from the Seventh Age, a cleric's tier 0 spell of the healing school. When struck, the caster has a 25 percent chance to gain Absorption II for 6 seconds.
